# End <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
End:Void
```

## Description

Stops the program right away. Everything that is output so far is written out first, and the exit code is 0.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print "before"
End
Print "never printed"
```

```text
before
```
